title: Authority boundaries
summary: Source Editor owns conventional/materialised source inspection and bounded mutation. Development Desk / Semantic Source Store owns semantic object creation, revision authority and materialisation. NewShell CLI/UI may bind directly to Source Editor objects but does not become source authority. POSIX, Process, Atomic File, Archive and Binary remain separate platform authorities and should be consumed rather than copied into the editor.
invariants: Do not create a second semantic source store inside Source Editor.
Do not implement private process, POSIX, archive, crypto or binary-layout subsystems inside the editor.
Generation-checked source mutation must fail closed when the loaded source generation has changed.
Once an edit operation exists in Source Editor, NewShell development should dogfood it rather than bypassing it with sed/perl/Python rewrites.
